ev.q: CDC quantified change in mean weekly seizure-related ED visits during April 1–December 29 across 3 years
the number of weekly seizure-related ED visits declined by 16% overall to 19,824
In children aged 0–9 years, febrile seizures accounted for approximately one third of all seizure-related ED visits in all 3 years
Percentage change in mean weekly seizure-related ED visits was assessed by comparing 2020 data with corresponding data from 2019 and 2021.
To examine trends in weekly seizure- or epilepsy-related (seizure-related) ED visits
NSSP collects deidentified electronic health record data from EDs and other health care settings.

methods_quotes.q: CDC quantified change in mean weekly seizure-related ED visits during April 1–December 29 across 3 years
Percentage change in mean weekly seizure-related ED visits was assessed by comparing 2020 data with corresponding data from 2019 and 2021.
CIs were constructed using the percentile bootstrap method using 1,000 replicate samples of the weekly counts.
All analyses were restricted to EDs that reported consistently more complete data throughout the study period
